en.heroTitle: Start with a robot that works. Make it yours.
en.heroLead: We're a small team from Novi Sad building robots on camera, failures included, and teaching what we learn. Bringup is the tool we use to design them: boards, printed parts, firmware and the parts list, kept in agreement.
en.heroNote: Early testing. Free while we learn.
en.seriesLead: We document our first robot from a sentence to its first drive. Each episode teaches one thing you'd need to build your own.
en.s1: We describe a robot to an AI
en.s6d: and what broke on the way.
en.g1d: Design and change robots before anyone else.
en.g2d: Start from our robots and change them to fit your idea.
en.g3d: Build the robot from the videos yourself.
en.tryTitle: Already use Claude Code? Add Bringup in one line.
en.tryLead: Bringup is an MCP server. Add it, then ask Claude to start a design from one of our starter robots.
en.tryNote: Needs Node.js 22 or newer. Early and rough, so expect sharp edges.
en.joinLead: Leave your email and tell us what you'd like to build. We'll write when testing opens and when new episodes are out.
en.footer: Bringup · Novi Sad, Serbia · Follow the build on YouTube and Instagram.

sr.heroTitle: Kreni od robota koji radi. Napravi ga svojim.
sr.heroLead: Mi smo mali tim iz Novog Sada koji pravi robote pred kamerom, sa sve greškama, i uči druge onome što naučimo. Bringup je alat kojim ih projektujemo: ploče, štampane delove, firmver i spisak delova, usklađene međusobno.
sr.seriesLead: Snimamo našeg prvog robota od jedne rečenice do prve vožnje. Svaka epizoda uči jednu stvar koja ti treba da napraviš svog.
sr.g1d: Projektuj i menjaj robote pre svih.
sr.g2d: Kreni od naših robota i prilagodi ih svojoj ideji.
sr.tryTitle: Već koristiš Claude Code? Dodaj Bringup jednom linijom.
sr.tryLead: Bringup je MCP server. Dodaj ga, pa zamoli Claude da započne dizajn od nekog od naših početnih robota.
sr.tryNote: Potreban je Node.js 22 ili noviji. Rana verzija, očekuj grube ivice.
sr.fConsent: Šaljite mi imejlove o testiranju i serijalu. Mogu da se odjavim kad god hoću, a moji podaci se nikome ne daju.
sr.footer: Bringup · Novi Sad, Srbija · Prati pravljenje na YouTubeu i Instagramu.
sr.joinLead: Ostavi imejl i napiši šta bi voleo/la da napraviš. Javićemo se kad testiranje počne i kad izađu nove epizode.
